The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall after four guided sessions among learners from invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question

In invented learning gardens, what recall outcomes do guided-session trials report?

## Inclusion criteria

- Invented learning-garden or learning-harbor trials
- Reports a recall outcome after guided sessions
- Record supplied in the evaluation fixture

## Exclusion criteria

- Records outside the supplied invented fixture
- No recall outcome reported

## Query log

- 2026-10-07 | invented-index (fixture-001.json supplied corpus; no live backend queried) | 2 hits

## Notes

- Evaluation capture mode: criteria-approval checkpoint skipped by instruction.
- Synthesis, claims, and sources preserved verbatim from the fixture for deterministic integrity evaluation.
The amber garden trial reported 64% stronger recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial reported 64% stronger recall (Vale, 2024).
